description: Regression for the TELEMON_MOVE_ISSUE save (R1 Movement, Custodes mirror). The Telemon's objective is obj_nml_1 to the north-east, it has a planned charge on the enemy Sentinel Guard Sodality Beta 19.1" away to the south-east, and a 3" solid gantry (gantry-38) is touching its base on the north-east side. Before: the move was bent 70% toward the charge target and then cut short by the threat dodge, so it went 5.4" south-east and gained ~0.2" on the objective. After: the charge steer is dropped (even 70% only ends 10" away, needs <=9"), the 100mm base's path is checked against the engine's 11e solid-terrain rule so it detours around the gantry, and the suggestion card lists every adjustment under 'How this turn's move was shaped'.

steps.comment: what clicking the Telemon in the card's move order does

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("Planned charge on Sentinel Guard Sodality Beta is out of reach this turn")

steps.comment: ends within 13" of obj_nml_1 (starts 15.9"; the old charge-steered move ended 15.7" away)
